values.quote: leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds

values.meaning: delay after dash before recast is available
values.quote: can be recast after {{fd|0.2}} seconds of the dash ending

mechanics.claim: The initial cast is location-targeted and deals AoE magic damage to nearby enemies upon arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival

mechanics.claim: The recast is a repositioning blink to the return pad and deals no damage.
mechanics.quote: LeBlanc blinks to Distortion's return pad, regardless of range.

mechanics.claim: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade); the recast does not.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast (i.e. on the initial cast, not on recast/pad expiry).
If cast within 0.5 seconds of the cooldown ending, the cast is buffered and fires as soon as the cooldown ends; a similar 0.3s buffer applies to the recast.
mechanics.quote: Distortion will be buffered and cast as soon as the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cooldown ending.
